resources.string: Nothing here yet. Tap Edit to start writing.
Write your own poems, one to a page, and turn through them like a real book.

Your poems are saved as plain text files, named after each poem, in a folder you choose. Every folder inside it becomes a book on your bookshelf, and text files directly in it go in a book called Misc. Because it\'s outside the app, your poems are still there if you reinstall.
Pick or create a folder such as Documents/Poems, then allow PoetryBook to use it.
That folder couldn\'t be used. Please choose another one.
PoetryBook can no longer reach your poems folder. Choose it again, or pick a new one.
Every folder inside it is a book. Each poem is a text file in its book, named after its title. Text files directly in this folder go in the Misc book.
Choosing a different folder loads the books in that folder. Your current poems stay in the old folder.
The bookshelf will show the books in the folder you choose. Your current books and poems will be left in the old folder, where they are now.
No app found to open the folder
